generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
The KNNL reserves the right of rejecting all or any of the tenders without assigning any reasonsribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

If the percentage quoted by Contractor for work is below 90 Percentage of the estimated amount put to tender or recast amount put to tender, then successful bidder shall furnish an Additional Performance Security in the form of Bank Guarantee for an amount equal to the difference between the cost as per quoted percentage and 90Percentage of the estimated amount put to tender or recast amount put to tender. In case of contractor quotation rates above the 125 Percentage of the estimated rates then the amount over and above 125 Percentage will be withheld during the progress of work. The additional performance security will be released proportionately to the bill amount till the contractor achieves progress of the entire cost of the work as per the agreement.
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

All the above original certificates shall be produced at the time of opening of tenders for verification. Contractors who will not produce original certificates at the time of opening liable for rejection.
If any of the dates mentioned above happens to be a general holiday the next working day holds good.
Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever
Corrigendum will be published in the website http://kppp.karnataka.gov.infor all modification/ corrections if any.
A monthly programmed of works has to be submitted by successful bidder at the time of concluding agreement.
If any certificate/ information furnished by the bidder is found false, such bidder will be disqualified at the time of evaluation
The validity period for E.M.D. shall be for a minimum period of 90 plus 45 days from the date of opening of tenders.
The agency should upload all documents. The agency which has been blacklisted will be disqualified from the tender process.

As per proceedings of the Government of Karnataka and Government Order No. LD 300 LET 2006 Bangalore dated 18.01.2007 and Corrigendum dated 28.02.2007, 1% of the amount of cost approved as per the tender notification will be deducted from the bill at the time of payment as cess for the Karnataka State Building & Other Construction Works Welfare Board.

Mandatory Entry in Contract Management Module: As per the Government of Karnataka Notification No. FD 758 Exp-12/2023 dated 09.07.2024, implementation of the Contract Management Module on the Karnataka Public Procurement Portal (KPPP) is mandatory. The successful bidding agency/contractor shall strictly create the project activity schedules, define milestones, and enter day-to-day physical and financial progress directly into the Contract Management Module of the portal as per the prevailing government rules and timelines

Royalty on Minor Minerals (MDP) As per the Karnataka Upakhanija Riyayithi (Minor Mineral Concession) Rules 1994 read with the amendment Rules dated 17.03.2023, and Government of Karnataka/KNNL Circular the successful bidder shall procure minor minerals (sand, jelly/gravel, murrum, stone, etc. required for the work only from authorised mineral lease/quarry licence holders, and shall produce valid Mineral Dispatch Permits (MDP)/royalty payment receipts for the quantity of minerals utilised in the work along with each Running Account Bill, for verification by the Department. Use of minerals procured from unauthorised sources shall not be permitted. Where minerals are found to have been used without a valid MDP/royalty payment, royalty at 5 times the prescribed rate, together with 40 percentage Government Advance Premium (AP) and 10 percentage District Mineral Foundation Trust contribution thereon, shall be recovered from the contractors bills, besides other penal/contractual action as deemed fit by the Department.

Bidder Should upload the bid capacity calculated as per Bid Document Tender condition, the statements showing the value of existing commitment and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or Equivalent. False representations in the statements leads to disqualification of the tender as per applicable clause

Successful bidder should produce within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit for an amount equivalent to 5 % of the Contract price

itemList.description: Clearing and grubbing road land including uprooting rank vegetation, grass, bushes, shrubs, saplings and trees girth up to 300 mm, removal of stumps of trees cut earlier and disposal of unserviceable materials and stacking of serviceable material to be used or auctioned, including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness. By Mechanical Means using Dozer In area of light jungle (CSR Vol-3 I.No. 2.5 (a) Page No. 09)

Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work In all kinds of soils Depth upto 3 m (CSR Vol-1 I.No.1.14.1 Pg No.08)

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete Mix 1:3:6 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. (CSR Vol-1 I.No.2.1.3 Pg No.15)

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates for all Sub structures of building, Irrigation works, Sub structure works of bridges, Drain works & other parallel works from 0.50m to 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. (CSR Vol-1 I.No.2.4.2 Pg No.16)
Providing centering, shuttering, formwork, scaffolding, etc (CSR 2023-24 Vol-1 Page No.111)

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification (CSR Vol-1 I.No.2.11 (h) Pg No.18)

Providing and filling murrum / gravelly soil ( CNS soil ) for foundation or around pipes including cost of all materials, labour, spreading soil in layers of 100 to 150 mm, breaking clods, watering, compaction by earth masters to achieve density control of not less than 90 percent and all other ancillary operations complete. (CSR Vol-4 I.No.4.15 Pg No.61)

Supplying 450 mm dia P-3 Class R.C.C spun pipe ( safe for 6 kg / cm2 test pressure ) to work spot including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, taxes, duties, levies, royalty & all necessary works as applicable as per specification. (WRD CSR 2023-24 Vol-4 Part-1 I.No.7.21.2)

Laying and jointing 450 mm dia P-2 / P-3 class R.C.C spun pipes  true to line and level with perfect linking at joint including loading, unloading, rolling/ lifting and lowering into trench, applying soft soap to spigot and socket ends, cleaning inserting rubber sealing ring into correct position, jointing the pipes perfectly by jacking or other approved method, giving necessary hydraulic test at the specified pressure, cost of all jointing and water pressure testing materials, machinery, labour & all necessary works complete as per specification. (WRD CSR 2023-24 Vol-4 Part-1 I.No.7.22.2)

Providing and constructing 300 mm thick rubble stone pitching set in CM 1: 5 proportion by volume with pin headers at 2 per m2 including cost of all materials from approved source, labour, packing stone chips and mortar into joints, finishing, curing and all other ancillary operations complete. (WRD CSR 2023-24 Vol-4 Part-1 I.No.3.43)
